messages.S2「最後まで追跡するぞ！」で両隣の味方に攻撃レベル増加を配り、確率で操作パネル: A Pierce commander that grants Offense Level Up to adjacent allies with S2 Pursue Them to the End! and can order an Assist Attack from an ally to her right on the dashboard. More Resonance makes her stronger, and she generally wants to take the finishing blow herself.
messages.S2の援護攻撃: 使用時、最も多い共鳴の共鳴数1につき10/15/20%の確率で: **S2's Assist Attack**: On use, there is a 10/15/20% chance per point of the highest Resonance to order an Assist Attack from an ally to her right on the dashboard (that ally makes a one-sided attack with Skill 1 on the enemy she attacked). It references the count of the single largest Resonance; Resonances of different Sins are not added together. The dashboard order changes with Speed, so the ally who receives the order is not stable. If the highest Absolute Resonance is 4 or more, the target also receives 1/2 Damage Up, and with 4 or more Pride Absolute Resonance, 1/2 Pride Power Up as well.
messages.両隣への配布: 操作パネル上の両隣の味方に、S2は戦闘開始時に攻撃レベル増加3、: **Giving to both neighbors**: To the allies on both sides of her on the dashboard, S2 gives 3 Offense Level Up at Combat Start, and S1 To Me! gives 2 Defense Level Up. Her Defense skill restores 3/5 SP to both neighbors on use, up to 2 times.
messages.トドメを取る: バトルパッシブ「ピークォド号の船長」(傲慢×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで: **Taking the kill**: The combat passive Captain of the Pequod (3 Pride Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) grants Poise if the target is dead at the end of her attack; next turn she enters the Gas Harpoon state, restoring 7 SP to the 1/2 allies with the lowest SP other than herself and giving them 4 Poise. This Identity has special SP rules: her SP may rise when she defeats an enemy and fall when an ally does.
messages.S3「執着の銛」: 対象の失った体力と出血に応じて強化される4コイン。攻撃後に敵: **S3 — Harpoon of Obsession**: 4 Coins that grow stronger based on the target's lost HP and Bleed. If the enemy is staggered or dead after the attack, restores 10 SP to the 1 ally with the lowest SP plus (highest Absolute Resonance ÷ 2) more allies, and gives them 2 Poise and 4 Poise Count (up to 2/4 times, up to 4 allies healed).
messages.出血・火傷・呼吸: S1は出血、S2・S3は出血と火傷を付与し、S3とパッシブで: **Bleed, Burn, and Poise**: S1 inflicts Bleed, S2 and S3 inflict Bleed and Burn, and S3 and the passive handle Poise.
messages.S2を使って操作パネル上の両隣に攻撃レベル増加3を配る。両隣・右方の味方は速度順: Use S2 to give 3 Offense Level Up to both neighbors on the dashboard. Her neighbors and the ally to her right swap with Speed order, so check every turn who it will reach. The larger the Resonance of a single Sin (especially Pride), the more often Assist Attack triggers, and the more you can aim for Damage Up and Pride Power Up. Assist Attack hits with Skill 1, so the benefit is likely larger in teams with many Identities whose Skill 1 advances buffs or resources. Play support until the enemy weakens, then take the final blow yourself with S3 or similar to restore SP and trigger the passive.
